src='''def transform(grid):
    # The divider splits two aligned panels. Mark equal cells and use their shared
    # palette color for every unequal pair.
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] in (4, 7)), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        colors_a = {v for row in a for v in row}
        colors_b = {v for row in b for v in row}
        shared = sorted(colors_a & colors_b)
        bg = shared[0] if shared else 0
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(min(len(a[r]), len(b[r])))] for r in range(min(len(a), len(b)))]
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and grid[0][c] in (4, 7)), None)
    if col_sep is not None:
        a = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        colors_a = {v for row in a for v in row}
        colors_b = {v for row in b for v in row}
        shared = sorted(colors_a & colors_b)
        bg = shared[0] if shared else 0
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(min(len(a[r]), len(b[r])))] for r in range(len(grid))]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
